_comment: Tagrove free-tier model allowlist. Edit this file when Google changes models or limits; no code change needed. Exact RPM/RPD numbers are not listed here: check them in Google AI Studio (Rate limits page).
freeTierNotes: Free tier content may be used to improve Google products; paid tier content is not.
Rate limits apply per project, not per API key.
Daily request quotas (RPD) reset at midnight Pacific time.
Preview and experimental models have stricter limits.

models.notes: Cost-efficient, built for high-volume and simple data processing. Best first choice for large batches.
Small, cost-effective, built for use at scale.
Newest Flash model. Likely best quality; limits may be tighter than Flash-Lite.
Legacy preview model. May change or be removed; stricter limits likely.
Free tier is available, but Pro models usually have much tighter free limits. Keep last.

excludedReason: Not free, not vision-to-text, or not suitable for metadata generation (image generation, audio, video, music, embedding, robotics, Gemma, and paid-only Pro preview).
